name: Kita Dunmore
features: BLOOD HUNTER 2 (Alternate, laserllama v2.2; Banked of Okton's order). Rite Die d4, Rite save DC 12
Hunter's Bane: Occult Lore (Nature); Sinister Insight (bonus action, CON check, DC 8+CR)
Blood Rites known: Agony, Binding (each free once per rest, then Vital Sacrifice)
Crimson Offering (bonus action + Vital Sacrifice; 1 hour; Rite Die extra damage)
Vital Sacrifice: lose current and max HP equal to the Rite Die until a long rest
Order of the Pale Moon at level 3 (Okton gives only this order). Latent beast: Crow.
Banked: advantage on saves against losing control of the burn; can bleed the heat off with a Vital Sacrifice (drops one stage for 24 hours)
notes: Age 22, female. Pre-conversion level 2. Rank: Raw (converted day 3). Lanky, bandaged shoulder, dry grin. Gwenis's younger sister. Jokes to keep the heat down; fiercely protective.
